name: Hiyama Misao
source:
A high school girl who has yet to know love.

He lives together with her mother in a fatherless home.
She lives wild and free, and hates studying.
Possibly because of perceived inferiority of living in the countryside, she has dyed her hair and likes to show off, but deep down she is kind and takes people's feeling into account before acting. However, she gets embarrassed when praised like she doesn't want to show that side of her.

She often acts in a half-hearted manner as if things were out of her control.

[Translated from [url=http://venus66.sakura.ne.jp/misao.html]the official site[/url]]
